title: Golden Fairy Portal
description: A woman in a shimmering gold sequined bodysuit with large yellow butterfly wings stands centrally, raising one hand toward a beam of light. She wears a flower crown and is surrounded by surreal elements including a golden retriever puppy, red snakes, melting clocks, floating eyeballs, jellyfish, a stone archway, and a man stepping through a doorway portal.
prompt: A majestic woman with large translucent yellow butterfly wings wears a tight-fitting gold sequin bodysuit adorned with flowers, standing in a surreal dreamscape. She has a flower crown and raises one hand to a heavenly beam of light. At her feet sits a golden retriever puppy. The scene includes red snakes, melting Dali-style clocks on stone steps, floating eyeballs in a dark sky, jellyfish, an ancient stone ruin with ivy, an apple with a bite taken out, and a man in a red shirt stepping through a glowing doorway portal, highly detailed symbolic surrealism.
